## Design

### 2026-10-25 – So I started brainstorming ideas for the project and landed on a simple recorder idea, it records sounds and records it to an SD card, so as usual I brainstormed, landed on a basic idea:

**4h**

So I started brainstorming ideas for the project and landed on a simple recorder idea, it records sounds and records it to an SD card, so as usual I brainstormed, landed on a basic idea:

![Screenshot 2026-10-25 143749](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/PyBRq8PPAIR10a85zVadomccKWQcxryn/7de34253be43af84f59183217ad7199ce5b261354115063b78028f1be4e598a6.png)

Then I found out wait, the ESP32 doesn't have a built in usb so I need one, so I attached, one and it would simply allow me to program the ESP32, and power it.

![Screenshot 2026-10-25 143915](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/PyBRq8PPAIR10a85zVadomccKWQcxryn/bef8c4ad55d420342deb974d01aebf12f853ad1360da89319e70d901dcd8c8f1.png)

Then I found out you can use put any USB you need to use a converter; it can't just power the ESP32, it had to also send it data.

![Screenshot 2026-10-25 144227](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/PyBRq8PPAIR10a85zVadomccKWQcxryn/9091de166c0f37ded3cd848d28b4455f2a9ff2dae90c3d0e5d700c0bc46dd4a3.png)

Then I did some research about the ESP32s and I found a really simple one, it's called ESP32-S3-Zero, its a really small board, and it very capable for my project, doesn't so much stuff, its super cool and thank god I found out about this, It would be so annoying to wire even more stuff.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/PyBRq8PPAIR10a85zVadomccKWQcxryn/77f66dce66c8677cd181d91ca4a915947e36e6a4b00872c25bc0a61c5972cac6.png)
